sentences.en: The new product will not be distributed through conventional channels.
sentences.zh: 新产品不会通过传统渠道进行分发。

sentences.en: I dream of a society whose wealth is distributed fairly.
sentences.zh: 我梦想一个财富分配公平的社会。

sentences.en: Maybe you should make brochures for Interlingua and distribute them.
sentences.zh: 或许你应该为国际语制作一些宣传册然后散发出去。
